rule-of-72.title: Rule of 72
rule-of-72.intro: Estimate the doubling time of an investment or variable at a given rate with the Rule of 72, compared against the exact logarithmic value.

en.title: Rule of 72
en.intro: Estimate the doubling time of an investment or variable at a given rate with the Rule of 72, compared against the exact logarithmic value.

cobb-douglas.title: Cobb-Douglas Production
cobb-douglas.intro: Estimate output from a Cobb-Douglas production function Y = A·K^α·L^(1−α) given total factor productivity, capital, labor, and the capital share.

en.title: Cobb-Douglas Production
en.intro: Estimate output from a Cobb-Douglas production function Y = A·K^α·L^(1−α) given total factor productivity, capital, labor, and the capital share.

gdp-growth-rate.title: GDP Growth Rate
gdp-growth-rate.intro: Calculate the GDP growth rate as the percentage change of output from the previous period.

en.title: GDP Growth Rate
en.intro: Calculate the GDP growth rate as the percentage change of output from the previous period.

cross-elasticity.title: Cross-Price Elasticity
cross-elasticity.intro: Measure how the quantity demanded of one good responds to a price change of another, classifying them as substitutes or complements.

en.title: Cross-Price Elasticity
en.intro: Measure how the quantity demanded of one good responds to a price change of another, classifying them as substitutes or complements.

labor-force.title: Labor Force
labor-force.intro: Compute the total labor force as the sum of employed and unemployed persons.

en.title: Labor Force
en.intro: Compute the total labor force as the sum of employed and unemployed persons.

labor-force-participation.title: Labor Force Participation Rate
labor-force-participation.intro: Calculate the labor force participation rate — the labor force as a percentage of the working-age population.

en.title: Labor Force Participation Rate
en.intro: Calculate the labor force participation rate — the labor force as a percentage of the working-age population.

marginal-product-labor.title: Marginal Product of Labor
marginal-product-labor.intro: Compute the marginal product of labor as the extra output produced by one additional unit of labor (ΔQ/ΔL).

en.title: Marginal Product of Labor
en.intro: Compute the marginal product of labor as the extra output produced by one additional unit of labor (ΔQ/ΔL).

nominal-to-real.title: Nominal to Real Value
nominal-to-real.intro: Deflate a nominal value to real terms using an inflation (or deflator) rate, removing the effect of price change.

en.title: Nominal to Real Value
en.intro: Deflate a nominal value to real terms using an inflation (or deflator) rate, removing the effect of price change.

compound-amount.title: Compound Amount
compound-amount.intro: Find the future value of a lump sum under compound interest (principal times the growth factor) and the total interest earned.

en.title: Compound Amount
en.intro: Find the future value of a lump sum under compound interest (principal times the growth factor) and the total interest earned.

unemployment-rate.title: Unemployment Rate
unemployment-rate.intro: Compute the unemployment rate as the unemployed share of the labor force, and the implied employment count.

en.title: Unemployment Rate
en.intro: Compute the unemployment rate as the unemployed share of the labor force, and the implied employment count.

okuns-law.title: Okun's Law
okuns-law.intro: Apply Okun's law to relate the unemployment-rate gap to the output growth gap: Δu ≈ −½(growth gap).

en.title: Okun's Law
en.intro: Apply Okun's law to relate the unemployment-rate gap to the output growth gap: Δu ≈ −½(growth gap).

real-gdp.title: Real GDP
real-gdp.intro: Deflate nominal GDP to real GDP using a GDP deflator, and show the price-distortion component.

en.title: Real GDP
en.intro: Deflate nominal GDP to real GDP using a GDP deflator, and show the price-distortion component.

average-propensity-consume.title: Average Propensity to Consume
average-propensity-consume.intro: Compute the average propensity to consume (APC) — the share of income that is spent rather than saved, as consumption divided by income.

en.title: Average Propensity to Consume
en.intro: Compute the average propensity to consume (APC) — the share of income that is spent rather than saved, as consumption divided by income.

pv-annuity.title: Present Value of Annuity
pv-annuity.intro: Calculate the present value of a level annuity and the total amount discounted over the payment period.

en.title: Present Value of Annuity
en.intro: Calculate the present value of a level annuity and the total amount discounted over the payment period.

fv-annuity.title: Future Value of Annuity
fv-annuity.intro: Calculate the future value of a level annuity and the total interest earned over the payment period.

en.title: Future Value of Annuity
en.intro: Calculate the future value of a level annuity and the total interest earned over the payment period.

spending-multiplier.title: Government Spending Multiplier
spending-multiplier.intro: Compute the government spending multiplier k = 1/(1−MPC) and the associated tax multiplier.

en.title: Government Spending Multiplier
en.intro: Compute the government spending multiplier k = 1/(1−MPC) and the associated tax multiplier.

gdp-expenditure.title: GDP by Expenditure
gdp-expenditure.intro: Compute GDP using the expenditure approach: GDP = C + I + G + NX (consumption, investment, government spending, net exports).

en.title: GDP by Expenditure
en.intro: Compute GDP using the expenditure approach: GDP = C + I + G + NX (consumption, investment, government spending, net exports).

income-elasticity.title: Income Elasticity of Demand
income-elasticity.intro: Measure how demand responds to a change in income, classifying the good as a normal or inferior good.

en.title: Income Elasticity of Demand
en.intro: Measure how demand responds to a change in income, classifying the good as a normal or inferior good.

present-value.title: Present Value
present-value.intro: Discount a future sum to its present value at a given interest rate, and show the total discount.

en.title: Present Value
en.intro: Discount a future sum to its present value at a given interest rate, and show the total discount.

mpc-from-multiplier.title: MPC from Multiplier
mpc-from-multiplier.intro: Derive the marginal propensity to consume from the government spending multiplier: MPC = 1 − 1/k.

en.title: MPC from Multiplier
en.intro: Derive the marginal propensity to consume from the government spending multiplier: MPC = 1 − 1/k.

tax-multiplier.title: Tax Multiplier
tax-multiplier.intro: Compute the fiscal tax multiplier k_t = −MPC/(1−MPC) for the effect of a tax change on output.

en.title: Tax Multiplier
en.intro: Compute the fiscal tax multiplier k_t = −MPC/(1−MPC) for the effect of a tax change on output.

velocity-of-money.title: Velocity of Money
velocity-of-money.intro: Compute the income velocity of money from the equation of exchange: V = P·Y/M.

en.title: Velocity of Money
en.intro: Compute the income velocity of money from the equation of exchange: V = P·Y/M.

balance-of-trade.title: Balance of Trade
balance-of-trade.intro: Calculate the balance of trade (net exports) as exports minus imports, indicating a trade surplus or deficit.

en.title: Balance of Trade
en.intro: Calculate the balance of trade (net exports) as exports minus imports, indicating a trade surplus or deficit.

fisher-equation.title: Fisher Equation
fisher-equation.intro: Apply the Fisher equation: the nominal interest rate equals the real rate plus expected inflation.

en.title: Fisher Equation
en.intro: Apply the Fisher equation: the nominal interest rate equals the real rate plus expected inflation.

marginal-propensity-consume.title: Marginal Propensity to Consume
marginal-propensity-consume.intro: Compute the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) — the change in consumption per unit change in income.

en.title: Marginal Propensity to Consume
en.intro: Compute the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) — the change in consumption per unit change in income.

inflation-rate.title: Inflation Rate
inflation-rate.intro: Compute the inflation rate from two CPI observations and the absolute change in the price index.

en.title: Inflation Rate
en.intro: Compute the inflation rate from two CPI observations and the absolute change in the price index.

elasticity-demand.title: Price Elasticity of Demand
elasticity-demand.intro: Compute the midpoint price elasticity of demand and classify the good as elastic, inelastic, or unit-elastic.

en.title: Price Elasticity of Demand
en.intro: Compute the midpoint price elasticity of demand and classify the good as elastic, inelastic, or unit-elastic.
